title: Netanyahu Accuses Mamdani of ‘Hate Speech’ After Mayor’s Video Address
summary: The Israeli prime minister criticized Mr. Mamdani for releasing a video last week in which the mayor called for the federal government to arrest Mr. Netanyahu for war crimes.
